title: A Fast, Iterative Clock Skew Scheduling Algorithm with Dynamic Sequential Graph Extraction
problem: Clock skew scheduling (CSS) requires extracting timing paths between sequential elements, which dominates runtime in advanced CSS algorithms; sequential graph extraction is the performance bottleneck.
motivation: CSS can significantly improve design timing slack, but computational bottlenecks in graph extraction prevent rapid exploration of skew optimization potential in large designs.
method: Iterative CSS algorithm uses timing propagation to facilitate dynamic sequential graph extraction, avoiding full-graph construction. Comprehensive skew calculation incorporates multiple clock latency constraints. Slack optimization techniques achieve target latencies identified by skew analysis.
key_novelty: First iterative CSS algorithm that dynamically extracts only necessary sequential graph edges using timing propagation, reducing extracted edges by 90.05%.
contributions: Iterative CSS algorithm using timing propagation for dynamic graph extraction
Comprehensive skew calculation handling multiple clock latency constraints
Slack optimization techniques achieving target latencies
49.11× speedup vs. prior graph-extraction CSS, 27.01× vs. state-of-the-art with superior slack improvement
primary_theme: Fast iterative clock skew scheduling via dynamic sequential graph extraction
